description: This file is a React component named AssignmentSubmission, which provides a user interface for students to submit assignments, including uploading files, providing links, notes, and submitting via an API call. It also handles different assignment types like quizzes and regular submissions.

methods.name: AssignmentSubmission
methods.description: React functional component for rendering and handling assignment submission.

methods.name: handleFileChange
methods.description: Handles file input changes and updates the component state with selected files.

methods.name: handleSaveDraft
methods.description: Marks the current submission as a draft and provides user feedback.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Submits the assignment assessment via API, manages success/error states, and calls the optional callback.
